title: Cross-Modal Performance and Kinetic Tradeoffs in Photocatalytic Formulations
scientific_scope: All frozen numerical series for the four task modalities: product-evolution time courses, optical/action spectra, ultrafast transient traces, and cofactor-loading response.
analysis_unit: One complete formulation time course, spectrum, transient trace, or loading condition; neighboring curve points are not independent replicates.
missingness: No curator-imposed row deletion, random subsampling, or imputation is applied within the frozen task boundary.
license_boundary: The archived target article and source-data workbook are CC BY; every numerical row in the four frozen task modalities is bundled after identity-neutral projection.
warnings: Cross-modal association does not by itself establish a unique charge-transfer mechanism.
The loading scan has few settings, so an apparent optimum must be treated as a bounded observation rather than a universal optimum.
source_coverage_statement: The bundled files are complete within the scientific_scope declared for this task. This does not assert that every variable, record, or file in the upstream scientific source is included.
